key_insight: HECKTOR 2025 benchmarks multimodal PET/CT AI for head and neck cancer by combining tumor segmentation, recurrence-free survival prediction, and HPV status classification in one large multi-center challenge.
clinical_relevance: If robustly translated, these models could help streamline radiotherapy planning and support noninvasive risk stratification in head and neck oncology.
method: Multimodal PET/CT plus electronic health records
Three tasks: GTVp/GTVn segmentation, RFS prediction, HPV classification
Challenge benchmark with held-out test evaluation
evidence_signal: The challenge included over 1,100 patients from 10 centers, 35 registered teams, 15 final submissions, and top scores of Dice 0.75, concordance index 0.66, and balanced accuracy 0.56.
watch_item: Performance remains moderate, especially for HPV classification, so external validation and workflow integration are still needed before clinical use.
paper_title: HEad and neCK TumOR (HECKTOR) 2025: Benchmark of Segmentation, Diagnosis, and Prognosis in Multimodal PET/CT
